zh: 但逆胡跨據神州，中原未靖，翰常克心自誓，志吞醜虜，上成先王遺旨，下謝山海之責。
before: Yet the Hu still hold the Central Plain; I had hoped to cleanse them for Murong Hui’s sake.
after: But the rebel Hu barbarians straddle and hold the Divine Land, and the Central Plain is not yet pacified. I always steeled my heart and swore that I would swallow up the vile caitiffs, above to fulfil the late king's dying wish and below to discharge my duty to the realm between the mountains and the sea.
reason: The existing English omits the oath (常克心自誓，志吞醜虜) and the whole clause 下謝山海之責, and it renders 先王遺旨 loosely. The replacement covers every clause. Use it for each repeated use of this unit's English.
